description: Things in science Alex Crystal can’t stop thinking about: exoplanets around TRAPPIST-1, the golden angle in sunflowers, structural colour and starling murmurations, Voyager, the Wow! signal and the Drake equation, each as a live experiment, and the computer science and physics behind the site.
line: Exoplanets, the geometry of plants, the beauty of animals, computer science and physics, and the mysteries we keep chasing.
lede: Deep space, the geometry of plants, the extreme beauty of animals, human discovery and mystery, and the computer science and physics behind this site. Each one is a live experiment you can play with.
